title: Committee of Supply – Head T (Ministry of National Development)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head T (Ministry of National Development)

sections.label: Vibrant property market during pandemic
sections.summary: The property market has been vibrant over the past two years amidst the pandemic, largely due to delays in BTO construction raising resale prices.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: The property market has been vibrant over the past two years amidst the pandemic, largely due to the delays in BTO construction and, hence, resulting in higher resale market housing prices.

sections.label: Prime Local Public Housing scheme
sections.summary: The PLH scheme was introduced to manage evolving housing needs and trends, not so much about the housing bubble.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: One of the schemes that was introduced is the Prime Local Public Housing (PLH) scheme, and that is not so much about the housing bubble but to manage the evolving housing needs and trends that we are seeing in our country.

sections.label: Expanding PLH beyond core central
sections.summary: As the LTPR is strategic and plans materialise decades ahead, the Minister is asked if PLH will expand beyond core central regions.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: As the LTPR is more strategic in nature and with the plans materialising only in the decades ahead, can the Minister shed some light on whether there are plans to expand the PLH scheme to beyond the core central regions?

sections.label: Extending PLH to mature estates
sections.summary: The passage asks whether PLH could extend to popular mature estates, noting record-breaking prices and young adults wanting independence near parents.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: Would there be a possibility for the PLH scheme to be extended to popular mature estates?

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: With headlines last year heralding that our public housing in mature estates is being sold at record-breaking prices, it does not help that some young working adults do desire their own independence but yet still would like to live near their parents for mutual support.

sections.label: Subsidy clawback for Rochor, Kallang-Whampoa
sections.summary: The passage asks how the subsidy clawback was determined for Rochor and Kallang-Whampoa, how the 6% figure was reached, and its purpose.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The first question is: how was the subsidy clawback determined for Rochor and the Kallang-Whampoa developments?

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: How did the Government arrive at the figure of 6%?

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The second related question is what is the purpose of the clawback?

sections.label: Determining prime location developments
sections.summary: The passage asks how HDB determines which development would be considered as being in a prime location.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The third question concerning the PLH scheme is: how does the HDB determine which development would be considered as being in a prime location?

sections.label: Effects on nearby non-PLH flats
sections.summary: The question asks whether the Government has calculated or assessed likely effects on prices of non-PLH flats near PLH projects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Has the Government done calculations or made an assessment of the likely effects on the prices of non-PLH flats in close proximity to PLH projects?

sections.label: PLH subsidy clawback on resale
sections.summary: When a PLH flat is first sold on the open market, owners pay 6% of the higher of resale or valuation as a subsidy clawback.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: When a PLH flat is sold on the open market for the first time, owners will have to pay 6% of the higher of resale or valuation, as a subsidy clawback.

sections.label: MOP, lottery effect, windfall profits
sections.summary: A 10-year MOP may reduce speculators but does not sufficiently reduce the lottery effect, while reduced subsidies better tackle windfall profits and fairness.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Furthermore, having a 10-year MOP may reduce the number of property speculators, but it does not go far enough in reducing the lottery effect and merely kicks the can down the road.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Reduced subsidies at the onset better tackles the issue of windfall profits and the perception of fairness to the broader Singapore population, while giving less room for market distortion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: This is especially so when considering that there are already many HDB flats today located in various prime locations that are transacting at very steep market values and, hence, generating much windfall profits – a record 261 million-dollar transactions in 2021, based on The Straits Times article in January, for example.

sections.label: Housing timeline for single unweds
sections.summary: The question asks if MND can provide a timeline for single unweds to obtain housing and allocate housing by their third trimester.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Can MND provide a timeline for single unweds to obtain housing once they apply for it and also allow housing to be allocated to them by the third trimester of their pregnancy, so that they can welcome their newborn into their home from the day the baby is born?

sections.label: Lactation rooms and GFA threshold
sections.summary: The question asks whether MND will increase the minimum number of required lactation rooms and lower the GFA threshold.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Will MND increase the minimum number of lactation rooms currently required and lower the GFA threshold?

sections.label: BTO application rates 2020-2021
sections.summary: The Minister for National Development said there were 5.5 applications per BTO flat in 2021, after 5.8 in 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: The Minister for National Development, in his written answer to several Parliamentary Questions in January this year, said that there were 5.5 applications for each BTO flat in 2021, after an even higher 5.8 applications per flat in 2020.

sections.label: BTO flats for married couples
sections.summary: 30% of BTO flats are set aside for first-timer married couples with children.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: For example, 30% of BTO flats are set aside for first-timer married couples with children.

sections.label: Publishing priority scheme application numbers
sections.summary: Asks whether the Government will publish applications under each priority scheme as a percentage for every HDB BTO exercise after selection.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: In order for Singaporeans to better prepare for their own BTO plans going forward, would the Government publish the number of applications under each priority scheme as a percentage for every HDB BTO exercise after the selection process is completed?

sections.label: Priority for married couples, JSS pilot
sections.summary: Asks about increasing priority for first-timer married couples with children and newly-married couples, and an update on the JSS-Operator-Run pilot.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: From a national perspective, is there scope to increase priority for first-timer married couples with children and newly-married couples?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: Under the Joint Single Scheme (JSS), some applicants have cited difficulties in looking for a partner.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: Will HDB share an update about the JSS-Operator-Run (OR) pilot, where a flat mate will be assigned to the applicant?

sections.label: More flats under PPHS
sections.summary: Asks whether HDB will provide more flats under the Parenthood Provisional Housing Scheme and consider including unsold sale of balance flats, surrendered flats and confiscated flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: Will HDB provide more flats under the Parenthood Provisional Housing Scheme (PPHS) and consider including unsold sale of balance flats, surrendered flats and confiscated flats under BPHS?

sections.label: Rental flat application numbers since 2020
sections.summary: Asks the Minister to share the number of HDB applications since 2020 for rental flats under the Public Rental Scheme, IRH scheme and PPHS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Could the Minister share, since 2020, the number of applications HDB receives for rental flats under the Public Rental Scheme, the Interim Rental Housing Link (IRH) scheme and the PPHS?

sections.label: Rental households owning flats
sections.summary: Asks how many households formerly living in rental flats have been helped successfully to own their flats in the last three years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: How many households formerly living in rental flats have been helped successfully to own their flats in the last three years?

sections.label: Rental flat supply increase
sections.summary: An MP requests the Government significantly increase rental flat stock across flat sizes for lower- to middle-income households.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: Meanwhile, however, many of my residents continue to struggle with seeking their temporary home under the existing rental schemes, be it the family which applied for PPHS, only to be unsuccessful for five consecutive times, or the family which meets the stringent eligibility criteria and was even successful in applying for a public rental flat, only to be told that there are many applicants on the waiting list and of the long wait times.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: Hence, I would like to humbly request once again that the Government significantly increase the stock of rental flats across flat sizes, thereby creating a viable and expanded public rental scheme with an emphasis on ensuring that our lower- to middle-income households' needs are well looked after.

sections.label: JSS-OR single applicant pilot
sections.summary: Last December HDB launched the JSS-OR pilot where a social service agency operator pairs up single rental flat applicants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: Last December, HDB launched the JSS-OR pilot whereby an operator, which is a social service agency, will try to pair up single applicants for rental flats.

sections.label: Ineligible buyers and BTO waits
sections.summary: An MP asks what measures help Singaporeans ineligible for BTOs and ECs due to higher incomes, and whether HDB would allow them to buy at non-subsidised or tiered subsidised rates.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: What measures are available to assist Singaporeans who are ineligible for BTO flats and executive condominiums (ECs) due to their higher household incomes but who still find resale flats and private properties not so affordable?

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Would HDB consider allowing Singaporeans whose earnings exceed the household income ceiling to purchase BTOs and ECs at a non-subsidised or tiered subsidised rates?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: Chairman, long waiting times for BTO flats have been a persistent concern among Singaporeans with current average waiting times of around four to five years and, in some cases, six to seven years, where projects have been delayed by COVID-19.

sections.label: Shorter waiting period BTO plan
sections.summary: In 2017 the Government introduced a plan offering BTO flats with shorter waiting periods of two to three years, such as about 3,000 flats launched in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: In 2017, the Government specifically introduced a plan to offer BTO flats with shorter waiting periods of two to three years, such as approximately 3,000 flats launched in 2018 with a waiting time of 2.5 years.

sections.label: Two BTO application tracks
sections.summary: A potential approach would create two BTO application tracks: the current four- to five-year wait and an express lane for projects one to two years into construction.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: A potential approach would be to expand on HDB's existing initiatives and create two distinct application tracks for BTO flats: first, the current system with a four- to five-year wait; and second, some kind of BTO express lane for projects already one to two years into construction, resulting in a much shorter waiting time of two to three years.

sections.label: Baseline annual HDB supply
sections.summary: A certain baseline of HDB supply, say 15% to 30% of annual new stock, could be continually constructed every year regardless of prevailing BTO demand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: For instance, there could be a certain baseline of HDB supply, say 15% to 30% of the annual new stock, that is continually constructed every year, regardless of prevailing BTO demand.

sections.label: Singles flat eligibility age
sections.summary: The passage asks if the Ministry will build more flats ahead of launches, notes singles must be above 35, and states the Workers' Party position of lowering the eligibility age to 28.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: Will the Ministry consider building more such flats in the new towns ahead of their launches to support couples to get married and start their families without delay?

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: A single Singaporean has to be above 35 years of age to purchase a resale public housing flat or to apply for a Build-to-Order 2-room Flexi Flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: The Workers' Party's position is that the eligibility age for singles to buy a flat should be lowered to the age of 28.

sections.label: Singles proportion rise 2010-2020
sections.summary: Between 2010 and 2020, the proportion of singles among residents aged 25 to 29 rose from 74.6% to 81.6% for males and from 54% to 69% for females.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: Between 2010 and 2020, the proportion of singles among residents aged 25 to 29 rose from 74.6% to 81.6% for males and from 54% to 69% for females.

sections.label: Youths' top choices
sections.summary: The top choice selected by youths was to maintain strong family relationships, and the second choice was to have a place of my own.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: The top choice selected by our youths was to maintain strong family relationships while the second choice was "to have a place of my own".

sections.label: Housing for singles at 28
sections.summary: The Government should roll out more housing choices for singles to purchase public housing at age 28 rather than 35, and HDB says most new flat buyers use less than 25% of monthly household income for a 25-year loan.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: The Government should look into rolling out more housing choices for singles to purchase public housing at the younger age of 28 rather than 35 currently.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: According to HDB, most new flat buyers use less than 25% of their monthly household income to service their monthly instalments for a 25-year loan.

sections.label: HDB affordability and tenure
sections.summary: With lower employment security and reduced market predictability, affordability of HDB flat prices should be measured on a tenure less than 25 years, so prices should be priced lower.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: With lower employment security and reduced market predictability, affordability of HDB flat prices should be measured based on a tenure that is less than 25 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: HDB flat prices should, therefore, be priced lower to adequately reflect this new normal.

sections.label: Compensation for minority sellers
sections.summary: The passage asks HDB to review the possibility of allowing some form of compensation to minority sellers of flats based on HDB's independent valuation of the flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan
sentences.text: Like Mr Chong Kee Hiong before me, I am asking HDB if it could review the possibility of allowing some form of compensation to the minority sellers of the flats based on HDB's independent valuation of the flat.

sections.label: Refining EIP for minority residents
sections.summary: Asks whether EIP can be refined to avoid economically disadvantaging minority residents while preventing significant ethnic enclaves.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Is there room for us to refine EIP so that we do not economically disadvantage our minority residents while ensuring that we do not form significant ethnic enclaves?

sections.label: Noise at HDB sky gardens
sections.summary: Asks for additional enforcement powers to stop noise and disturbances at sky gardens affecting nearby residents.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: We all recognise that such public housing projects are considered to be representative of the new-generation of public housing in Singapore, with a focus on community bonding, greenery and lifestyle.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: However, the sky gardens located at HDB blocks, while still public spaces, are unique, because of the very close proximity to residents' homes, which means that any noise or disturbances at the gardens will directly affect these residents, especially if they occur at night.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The well-being of our residents is important, especially when the noise disturbances and disamenities have been going on for so many years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Therefore, I would like to ask if there could be additional enforcement powers to allow the authorities to put a stop to the noise and disturbances taking place at the sky gardens so that affected residents can have peace of mind and a good night's sleep.

sections.label: Gate access for residents' safety
sections.summary: Hopes MND would consider installing a gate allowing access only during the day and early evenings.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: For the safety, security and well-being of my residents, I sincerely hope that MND would consider installing a gate which allows access only during the day and early evenings.

sections.label: Higher bids for town improvement projects
sections.summary: States recent bid prices for town improvement projects like the Neighbourhood Renewal Programme are up to 50% higher than pre-tender estimates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: Against this backdrop, it is not surprising that recent bid prices for town improvement projects, like the Neighbourhood Renewal Programme, are up to 50% higher than pre-tender estimates.

sections.label: Temporary increase in NRP grants
sections.summary: Asks whether HDB can temporarily increase its NRP grants to Town Councils to cover short-term cost increases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: First, can HDB temporarily increase its NRP grants to Town Councils to cover these short-term cost increases?

sections.label: Singles' 2-room BTO flats
sections.summary: States singles can only buy 2-room subsidised BTO flats not in mature or prime locations, so flats sell less easily with lower value appreciation.

sentences.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong (West Coast)
sentences.text: Singles can only purchase 2-room Government-subsidised BTO flats which cannot be in mature estates nor prime location public housing.

sentences.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong (West Coast)
sentences.text: This means that their flats are less easily sold in the market, with relatively lower-value appreciation over time than the bigger flats.

sections.label: Resale flat price climb
sections.summary: Resale flat prices kept climbing despite cooling measures, with first-time buyers competing with former private condo owners, and many million-dollar flats sold.

sentences.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong (West Coast)
sentences.text: Despite the cooling measures applied, resale flat prices have continued to climb with first-time home buyers competing with those who are looking for bigger spaces after selling their private condominium units.

sentences.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong (West Coast)
sentences.text: We have also seen an unprecedented number of million-dollar flats being sold this season.

sections.label: Old Police Academy heritage study
sections.summary: In November 2021 MND announced a pilot heritage study for the Old Police Academy site to inform future studies and planning.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong)
sentences.text: Chairman, in November 2021, MND announced a pilot heritage study for the Old Police Academy site, with a view to informing both future studies on other sites and the larger assessment and planning process, how we can continue to strengthen this, including the possibility of formalising a framework by which such heritage studies may be required.

sections.label: Older population share projection
sections.summary: People aged 65 and older are projected to reach 47% of the population by 2050.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: People aged 65 and older are projected to hit 47% of our population by 2050.

sections.label: Community Care Apartments launch
sections.summary: MND, HDB and MOH launched the first Community Care Apartments in Bukit Batok, and all 169 units were oversubscribed within one day.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Recognising our nation’s changing demographics, last February, MND partnered HDB and MOH to launch the first Community Care Apartments in Bukit Batok.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Last year, all 169 Community Care Apartment units were oversubscribed within one day.

sections.label: Public rental flat households
sections.summary: About 50,000 households lived in PRS rental flats as of 2020, and 4,500 moved on to buy homes over five years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: As of 2020, about 50,000 households lived in rental flats under the PRS.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: I note the recent announcement which shared that 4,500 households living in public rental flats moved on to buy their own homes over the past five years with the help of various HDB schemes and grants.

sections.label: PPVC construction method use
sections.summary: PPVC improves site safety and costs about 10% more than conventional methods, and has been required for some residential GLS sites since 2014.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: Since most of the installation works and related manpower are offsite, this also results in improved safety on the construction site.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: It costs about 10% more than conventional building methods, but is expected to come down in price as more projects use this method, which has been experienced in overseas markets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: The use of PPVC has been required for some residential, non-landed Government land sales sites since 2014.

sections.label: Building carbon emissions share
sections.summary: Buildings account for over 20% of Singapore's carbon emissions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: Chairman, buildings account for over 20% of Singapore's carbon emissions.

sections.label: Hougang lift upgrading access
sections.summary: Six Hougang SMC HDB blocks still lack same-floor lift access, with about 150 such blocks left in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I return to the issue of lift upgrading for the six blocks of HDB flats in Hougang SMC where there are still certain units which do not have the same floor access to lifts and this is a very real issue affecting a number of my residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: We were told that there are about 150 such HDB blocks left in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: At COS last year, the Minister replied to my cut and said that, for blocks where the costs are still too high, it will not be prudent to offer the Lift Upgrading Programme (LUP).

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: He also said that while the Government continues to explore new technical methods to bring down LUP costs, the Government had also introduced the Lift Access Housing Grant of up to $30,000 in 2020, which is supposed to assist residents with urgent mobility or medical needs to move to another flat with direct lift access.

sections.label: Facilities management transformation barriers
sections.summary: FM transformation covers design for maintainability, procurement, smart FM and manpower development, but businesses cite high technology costs and Progressive Wage Model worker costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: COMMITTEE OF SUPPLY – HEAD T (MINISTRY OF NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT) (Creating an inclusive and sustainable home)

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: I understand that in the Facilities Management (FM) sector's transformation, the key areas identified are design for maintainability, procurement, smart FM and manpower development.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: However, some businesses have cited the delay in adopting technologies due to the higher implementation cost and the immediate impact of workers' cost with the Progressive Wage Model.

sections.label: Accelerating FM technology adoption
sections.summary: The question asks the Minister to share steps to accelerate FM industry transformation and encourage new technology adoption.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: Could the Minister share the steps taken to accelerate the transformation of the FM industry and encourage the adoption of new technologies?

sections.label: Allowing HDB residents to keep cats
sections.summary: The speaker urges a policy change to accept that HDB residents may keep cats, which can be removed if they cause disamenities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: All four reasons are terrible."  I encourage everyone to read Mr Tan's full post on this issue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: It is time that we progress on this issue and change our policy to accept what we already accept in reality – that HDB residents are allowed to keep cats, who can be removed if they are found to cause disamenities within the community.

sections.label: National effort against issue
sections.summary: A national level effort by MND and its agencies may be needed to combat it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: A national level effort by MND and its agencies may be needed to combat it.

sections.label: OneService App feedback and features
sections.summary: Feedback on the OneService App includes helpfulness, unresolved cases, a suggestion for summary reports, and a question on new features' impact.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: Anecdotal sharing suggests that many have found this app very helpful with ease of use and some having their feedback addressed in a timely manner.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: However, I have also received feedback that some cases have been closed or deemed resolved by the agency, but the action done did not exactly resolve the issue raised or it was not satisfactorily managed.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: One suggestion is for a summary report of the actions taken by all agencies to be provided to the complainant so that they can be actively involved in the matter's closure.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: With the OneService App now evolving to include more features, such as the "Help Neighbour" and parking facilities, can the Municipal Services Office (MSO) share the impact of these new features on the user base?

sections.label: HDB refers cases to mediation
sections.summary: HDB refers unresolved neighbour cases to the Community Mediation Centre, and over 70% of cases are resolved since 2014.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: In cases where neighbours are unable to resolve their differences, HDB refers cases to the Community Mediation Centre (CMC).

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: And since 2014, over 70% of cases are resolved through CMC.

sections.label: Further assistance and Help Neighbour cases
sections.summary: MSO is asked what further assistance it can provide and for the number and nature of Help Neighbour cases since June 2021.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: So, besides mediation, what further assistance can MSO provide to address such disamenities?

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: And since the launch of the "Help Neighbour" function in June 2021, can MSO update the number of cases that was received thus far and the nature of the cases?

sections.label: MSO tracking and coordinating cases
sections.summary: MSO is asked how it tracks and coordinates all cases until resolution, especially complex ones needing other agencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: How does MSO track and coordinate issues for all cases until resolution, especially complex ones that may require collaboration with other agencies?

sections.label: Integrating noise concerns in app
sections.summary: A suggestion is made to integrate a dedicated category in the app for residents to raise noise concerns.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Can we go further to integrate this, for example, by allowing residents to raise concerns about noise issues in the app in a dedicated category?

sections.label: Senior-friendly features in HDB estates
sections.summary: A suggestion is made to integrate senior-friendly features and services from Community Care Apartments into existing HDB estates and mature estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Can we look into integrating senior-friendly features that come with the new Community Care Apartments into our existing HDB estates?

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Some of the services in the optional service packages, like housekeeping, meal services and medical escorts, can also be designated to service providers and even senior activity centres in the community and extended to all mature estates with a high population of seniors.

sections.label: MSO municipal services plans
sections.summary: A question asks what MSO plans are to keep municipal services efficient and resident-centric in the endemic phase.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: As we enter the endemic phase of living with the virus, what are MSO's plans to ensure that municipal services are efficient and resident-centric?

sections.label: Neighbour's disturbed night, doctor
sections.summary: The next morning, the neighbour had to see a doctor because his blood pressure rose after a disturbed night's rest.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: The next morning, we heard that the neighbour had to see a doctor because his blood pressure went up after a disturbed night's rest.

sections.label: Residents' neighbour complaints rising
sections.summary: Members have received complaints from residents about issues and disputes with neighbours, more prevalent in the past two years of work from home and home-based learning.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: I am sure Members have had their fair share of complaints from residents of issues and disputes with their neighbours.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: This has become more prevalent these two years with work from home and home-based learning practices.

sections.label: Advice to talk, make friends
sections.summary: The speaker advises residents with such issues to first talk nicely to neighbours, and to make friends with neighbours when there are no issues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: The uncle could have vented his displeasure by banging on our common wall and that would have embarrassed me in front of my guests.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: Therefore, I always advise my residents with such issues to first talk nicely to their neighbours.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: Actually, we should go further upstream and make friends with our neighbours when there are no issues.

sections.label: Asking MSO about disputes
sections.summary: The speaker hesitates to ask MSO what more Government could do, but asks the Minister to share insights on addressing neighbourly disputes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: I do hesitate to ask the MSO what the Government could do more to address such disamenities and neighbourly disputes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: But with the spectrum of neighbourly disputes that MND has come across, I would appreciate if the Minister could share some insights and suggestions on how such matters could be addressed.

sections.label: Subsidised flat sales over rentals
sections.summary: The focus is to sell flats to Singaporeans, including low-income households, at highly subsidised prices rather than offer rental units at subsidised rents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: But the experience of these cities shows that the private market will often not provide adequately for the low-income or even middle-income families.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: That is why our focus is to sell flats to Singaporeans, including low-income households, at highly subsidised prices rather than offer them rental units at subsidised rents.

sections.label: BTO income ceiling coverage
sections.summary: The current $14,000 income ceiling for BTO flats covers more than eight in 10 Singaporean households.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: To Ms Poh Li San's question, the current income ceiling of $14,000 for BTO flats already covers more than eight in 10 Singaporean households.

sections.label: Public housing building programme
sections.summary: Work is ongoing to minimise construction delays and ramp up building, with 23,000 flats yearly in 2022 and 2023 and up to 100,000 from 2021 to 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Since last year, we have been working closely with the industry on two important tasks: first, we are working hard to minimise delays in the ongoing construction of flats; and second, we are ramping up our building programme to meet the strong demand for public housing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We will launch 23,000 flats per year in 2022 and 2023 and are prepared to launch up to 100,000 flats from 2021 to 2025, if needed.

sections.label: New flats delivered in 2021
sections.summary: In 2021, about 14,500 new flats were delivered, more than 9,400 in 2020 and 13,500 in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In 2021, we delivered about 14,500 new flats, more than the 9,400 flats in 2020 and the 13,500 flats in 2019, pre-pandemic.

sections.label: PPHS supply additions
sections.summary: 800 more PPHS units are on track to be added by mid-2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Mr Chong Kee Hiong, Mr Gan Thiam Poh and Mr Gerald Giam asked about the PPHS supply.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We are on track to add 800 more units by mid-2023.

sections.label: Falling application rates
sections.summary: Application rates have fallen from about 20 times to about nine times in the most recent exercises.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: As a result of these efforts, application rates have fallen significantly, from about 20 times to about nine times in the most recent exercises – though that is still high.

sections.label: Flats with shorter waiting times
sections.summary: More than 4,000 flats with waiting times of around three years or less were launched in November last year and February this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In November last year and February this year, we launched more than 4,000 flats with waiting times of around three years or less.

sections.label: Prime location public housing model
sections.summary: The PLH model builds affordable flats in prime locations, with over three applicants per 3-room and over 10 per 4-room flat, and integrates sold and rental flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: One major policy we rolled out last year was the new prime location public housing model (PLH), after many years of study and engagement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: This allows us to build flats in prime locations and keep them affordable, so that these areas remain diverse and inclusive and do not become places where only the well-to-do can live.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: They attracted a lot of interest, with more than three applicants for each 3-room flat and more than 10 for each 4-room flat.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: To Ms Mariam Jaafar's question, our approach has been to integrate sold and rental flats in the same BTO projects, including in prime areas where feasible, to enable Singaporeans across different backgrounds to build neighbourly ties, form community bonds, build a stronger and more cohesive community and society.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We have completed two new blocks that integrate both rental and owned HDB flats in the same block, and more are in the pipeline.

sections.label: Subsidy recovery rate
sections.summary: The subsidy recovery rate recovers additional subsidies as a percentage of the resale price when the flat is sold on the open market.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: This would go against the intention of the PLH model.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We size the subsidy recovery rate to recover these additional subsidies, as a percentage of the resale price, when the flat is sold on the open market.

sections.label: EIP limits reached
sections.summary: Nearly one in three HDB blocks and 16% of HDB neighbourhoods have reached one or more EIP limits.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Even today, nearly one in three HDB blocks, and 16% of HDB neighbourhoods, have reached one or more of the EIP limits.

sections.label: HDB buyback for EIP households
sections.summary: HDB will buy back flats case-by-case for EIP-constrained households with genuine selling difficulties, offered to those who owned their homes at least 10 years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Having done so carefully, we have decided that, for EIP-constrained households who face genuine difficulties in selling their HDB flats, HDB will buy back their flat on a case-by-case basis.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: To ensure that we focus on households with the greatest needs, we will offer this buyback assistance to those who have owned their homes for at least 10 years.

sections.label: Valuation and fair offer
sections.summary: If conditions are met, HDB appoints a licensed valuer and makes a fair offer so the household is not unduly disadvantaged due to EIP.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: If HDB assesses that the conditions have been met, it will appoint a professional licensed valuer to perform a valuation and HDB will make a fair offer, so that the household is not unduly disadvantaged due to EIP.

sections.label: Buyback chosen over grant
sections.summary: Because buyers and sellers might artificially lower transaction prices to exploit a grant, HDB decided to buy back flats from EIP-constrained households in genuine need.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Second, some buyers and sellers might well artificially lower their transaction price to take advantage of the grant and it would be hard to guard against this.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: So, on balance, we have decided that the most feasible option would be to buy back flats from EIP-constrained households in genuine need.

sections.label: Housing grant for families
sections.summary: Under the Scheme, families can receive a $35,000 housing grant.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Under the Scheme, families can receive a $35,000 housing grant.

sections.label: Higher grant and 3-room flats
sections.summary: The grant will increase to $50,000, and families can buy 3-room flats with a shorter lease, offered for the first time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: First, we will increase the grant to $50,000, to help more tenants afford a home.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Second, we will allow families to buy 3-room flats with a shorter lease to meet a wider range of housing needs, rather than just short-lease 2-room flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: This is the first time that we will offer new 3-room flats on shorter leases.

sections.label: S-Pass and Work Permit arrivals
sections.summary: Between November 2021 and February 2022, around 16,000 S-Pass and Work Permit holders from three sectors entered Singapore monthly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Between November 2021 and February 2022, around 16,000 S-Pass and Work Permit holders from the Construction, Marine and Process sectors entered Singapore each month.

sections.label: MYE removal and levy framework
sections.summary: The MYE framework will be removed in 2024 with a new levy framework, and the Construction Dependency Ratio Ceiling reduced from 1:7 to 1:5.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: First, we will remove the current Man-Year Entitlement (MYE) framework in 2024 and introduce a new levy framework that encourages off-site prefabrication work.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Second, we will reduce the Construction Dependency Ratio Ceiling, from 1:7 to 1:5.

sections.label: Grants for building retrofits
sections.summary: $63 million in grants will help building owners undertake retrofits and achieve higher standards of energy efficiency and sustainability.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Retrofitting older buildings costs a lot more upfront and it may take several years to recoup this investment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: This is why we will provide $63 million in grants to help building owners undertake retrofits and achieve higher standards of energy efficiency and sustainability.

sections.label: Zero-energy certification grants and audits
sections.summary: A zero-energy certification project can receive up to $1.2 million, applications open in the second quarter, and energy audits are being explored.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: For example, a project that achieves zero-energy certification can receive up to $1.2 million under the enhanced scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: You can apply for this scheme from the second quarter of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We are also exploring whether to require building owners to conduct energy audits to improve the energy performance of their buildings.

sections.label: Retained nature parks buffer zones
sections.summary: Rifle Range Nature Park and Mandai Mangrove and Mudflat were retained as buffer zones for core biodiversity habitats, to be completed by mid-2026 with Khatib Bongsu Nature Park.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: For example, we have retained the Rifle Range Nature Park and the Mandai Mangrove and Mudflat, which were originally intended for housing and industry respectively, because they are important buffer zones for our core biodiversity habitats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: These nature parks will be completed by mid-2026, along with Khatib Bongsu Nature Park.

sections.label: Park connector network length
sections.summary: Singapore has around 370 kilometres of park connectors, more than seven times the length of Singapore from east to west, and more are being added.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Today, we have around 370 kilometres of park connectors – more than seven times the length of Singapore from east to west – and we keep adding more.

sections.label: Heritage buildings gazetted for conservation
sections.summary: Close to 7,200 heritage buildings have been gazetted for conservation despite Singapore's short nation-building history.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Despite our short nation-building history, our conservation efforts have achieved good success, with close to 7,200 heritage buildings gazetted for conservation.

sections.label: Conserving six buildings, parade square
sections.summary: Six buildings, including four within the new housing estate, are planned for conservation, and part of the parade square will be retained as open space.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Taking into consideration the study findings and the feedback received, we plan to conserve six buildings, including four within the new housing estate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Part of the parade square will also be retained as an open space.

sections.label: Structured heritage impact assessment framework
sections.summary: A structured heritage impact assessment framework will be implemented, requiring agencies for public projects likely to cause major impact to significant heritage sites to consult URA and NHB.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In response to Mr Xie Yao Quan, we are glad to announce that we will formally implement the structured heritage impact assessment, or HIA, framework.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Under this new framework, developing agencies for public projects that are likely to cause major impact to significant heritage sites will need to consult URA and NHB, to determine if a heritage study is required.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: For sites that require an HIA, which is the most extensive of heritage studies that may be imposed, agencies will engage consultants to provide an additional and more detailed assessment on the significance of each heritage element and the recommended interventions.

sections.label: User base growth since 2015
sections.summary: Since its launch in 2015, the user base has increased 10-fold to more than 430,000 users.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Since its launch in 2015, our user base has increased 10-fold to more than 430,000 users.

sections.label: Municipal feedback case volume
sections.summary: Agencies and Town Councils receive over 4,000 municipal feedback cases daily.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Every day, agencies and Town Councils receive over 4,000 cases of feedback on municipal issues.

sections.label: Photo evidence and case labels
sections.summary: Photo evidence is provided on resolution of straightforward cases, and cases are labelled Resolved or Replied.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: First, photo evidence is provided upon resolution of straightforward cases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: This initiative has been implemented since 2020 for feedback concerning public cleanliness and has since expanded to include other straightforward issues, such as the maintenance of common property in HDB estates, HDB car parks and commercial properties, and lights along covered walkways and footpaths.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Where, previously, all cases were labelled as "Closed" once the agency had responded to the feedback, now they are labelled as either "Resolved" or "Replied".

sections.label: HDB blocks under LUP
sections.summary: More than 5,000 HDB blocks have benefited from LUP.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: More than 5,000 HDB blocks have thus benefited from LUP.

sections.label: Switch work booths initiative
sections.summary: PA, HDB and Switch offer work booths, used by over 100 individuals since last December.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: First, we are collaborating with the business community and the public to harness innovative ideas and bring practical solutions to residents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: We facilitated the "Switch for Community" initiative by the People's Association (PA), HDB and Switch, which offers affordably priced and conveniently located Switch work booths for residents whose attempts to study or work-from-home are affected temporarily by renovation works or other forms of noise.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Since its launch last December, over 100 individuals have used the work booths located at the Bukit Timah Community Club and Trivelis Residents' Network in Clementi.

sections.label: Alliance for Action on group-buy
sections.summary: PA and HDB will co-lead an Alliance for Action to study group-buy activities in HDB estates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: In the spirit of Singapore Together, PA and HDB will also be co-leading an Alliance for Action (AfA) to study practical solutions to better facilitate group-buy activities in HDB estates.

sections.label: Community Advisory Panel on noise
sections.summary: A Community Advisory Panel on Neighbourhood Noise will be set up to define unacceptable noise and civic norms.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: As part of a holistic response, we intend to set up a Community Advisory Panel on Neighbourhood Noise to look at defining what is deemed as unacceptable noise disturbances, as well as what constitutes good civic norms that residents should observe, to reduce noise disturbances to their neighbours.

sections.label: Help Neighbour app referrals
sections.summary: "Help Neighbour" has referred 272 cases of seniors, rough sleepers, cardboard collectors and tissue sellers to social agencies, about 50% new cases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Miss Cheryl Chan also asked for an update on the "Help Neighbour" feature in the OneService app since its launch in last September.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Thus far, "Help Neighbour" has referred 272 cases of seniors in need, rough sleepers, cardboard collectors and tissue sellers to the social agencies for targeted assistance – of which, about 50% were new cases unknown to the agencies.

sections.label: Supporting heartland merchants
sections.summary: Study findings will shape national programmes for heartland merchants, with follow-up on feedback and partnership with Enterprise Singapore under "Our Heartlands 2025".

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: The findings from the study will help to shape and refine national programmes and plans to support our heartland merchants.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: We will follow up on participants’ feedback and partner Enterprise Singapore to rejuvenate our heartland spaces with new experiences as part of "Our Heartlands 2025", a new initiative announced by Minister of State Low Yen Ling during MTI’s COS.

sections.label: URA engagement on Singaporeans' concerns
sections.summary: From July to September last year, URA engaged over 5,800 Singaporeans through polls and workshops on their values, hopes and concerns for the future.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: From July to September last year, URA engaged more than 5,800 Singaporeans through polls and workshops, to better understand Singaporeans’ values, hopes and concerns for the future.

sections.label: Long-term plan review focus areas
sections.summary: The LTPR's key focus areas are strengthening the resilience, flexibility and inclusiveness of long-term plans and strategies amid greater future uncertainties.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Given the greater uncertainties we face in the future, key focus areas of the LTPR would be strengthening the resilience, flexibility and inclusiveness of our long-term plans and strategies.

sections.label: Grants and subsidies for flat ownership
sections.summary: The Government already provides generous grants and subsidies to help most Singaporeans own a BTO or resale flat directly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: To Mr Louis Chua's suggestion of a Rent-To-Buy model, our Government already provides generous grants and subsidies to help most Singaporeans own either a BTO or resale flat directly.

sections.label: CPF mortgage payments and Rent-To-Buy
sections.summary: Flat buyers generally need little or no cash outlay as CPF contributions pay mortgage loans, so it is unclear how Rent-To-Buy is better.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Flat buyers in Singapore, generally, require little or no cash outlay in servicing the payments for their flats as their mortgage loans can be paid using their CPF contributions, which leaves flexibility for them to pursue other aspirations and goals with their disposable income.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Therefore, it is not clear how Rent-To-Buy is better for the aspiring Singapore home owner.

sections.label: HDB raised multi-storey carparks
sections.summary: HDB research with SUTD on the kampung spirit led to a new model of raised multi-storey carparks with porous ground-floor social space.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: In July last year, HDB completed a research project, in collaboration with Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD), using data analytics and behavioural studies to look at how to foster the "kampung spirit" in our heartlands.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: One of the findings was the importance of visual connectivity and the development of a social hub to promote neighbourly interactions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: This led HDB to develop a new model of "raised" multi-storey carparks, where the carpark levels are lifted to introduce a porous space on the ground floor where residents from surrounding blocks can interact and gather for social activities.

sections.label: Switch for Community initiative
sections.summary: The Switch for Community initiative was piloted in Bukit Timah, offering affordably priced work booths for residents affected by noise.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: For example, we piloted the “Switch for Community” initiative in Bukit Timah which offers affordably priced and conveniently located Switch work booths for residents whose attempts to study or work from home are affected by noise concerns.

sections.label: Community Advisory Panel on noise
sections.summary: MSO and MCCY will set up a Community Advisory Panel on Neighbourhood Noise.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: In this regard, MSO and MCCY will set up a Community Advisory Panel (CAP) on Neighbourhood Noise.

sections.label: Community norms by CAP
sections.summary: The community norms developed by CAP will facilitate mediation and decision-making at the Community Disputes Resolution Tribunal and serve as reference for public advisories.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: The “community norms” developed by CAP will facilitate mediation and decision-making at the Community Disputes Resolution Tribunal, as well as serve as a useful reference for our public advisories.

sections.label: Single unwed parents' rental applications
sections.summary: Single unwed parents can generally receive the outcome of rental flat applications within three weeks of submitting all required information.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Generally, single unwed parents can receive the outcome of their rental flat applications within three weeks of submitting all required information, although more time may be required for complex cases.

sections.label: ComLink scaled up nationwide
sections.summary: ComLink is a flagship project led by MSF being scaled up nationwide to cover some 14,000 families over the next few years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: ComLink is a flagship project led by MSF and it is being scaled up nationwide to cover some 14,000 families over the next few years.

sections.label: Helping households own homes
sections.summary: The team helped about 110 households own homes, with 230 more expected to apply, and first-timers can get up to $80,000 from the Enhanced CPF Housing Grant.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Over the past two years, the team has successfully helped about 110 households own their own homes and another 230 should be ready to apply for a flat in the next one to two years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: For example, first-timers can tap on the Enhanced CPF Housing Grant and receive up to $80,000, on top of already subsidised flat prices, if they purchase a new flat.

sections.label: Rental households moving to flats
sections.summary: Between 2019 and 2021, over 2,200 rental households moved into flats of their own.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Between 2019 and 2021, over 2,200 rental households have moved into flats of their own.

sections.label: EASE accessibility features demand
sections.summary: EASE features include grab bars, mobility ramps and slip-resistant toilet floor tiles, and over 250,000 households have benefited so far.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: These features include grab bars, mobility ramps for wheelchair users and slip-resistant treatment to toilet floor tiles.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: There has been strong demand and over 250,000 households have benefited from EASE so far.

sections.label: Second CCA pilot in Queenstown
sections.summary: A second CCA pilot will launch this year in Queenstown with about 200 units offered, after the Bukit Batok pilot was well-received.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The first pilot we launched last year in Bukit Batok was very well-received, with an application rate of 4.2 applicants per unit.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: So far, over 90% of the units offered have been booked.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: To meet the demand for assisted living, we will launch a second CCA pilot this year in Queenstown.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: About 200 CCA units will be offered and the project will also include other flat types.

sections.label: BCA Accessibility Fund co-funding
sections.summary: Building owners can tap co-funding under BCA's Accessibility Fund for voluntary upgrading providing accessibility and inclusive features like lactation rooms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Building owners can tap on co-funding under BCA's Accessibility Fund to undertake voluntary upgrading to provide accessibility and inclusive features like lactation rooms.

sections.label: Malay rental households and Fresh Start
sections.summary: Over 1,800 Malay rental households progressed to home ownership between 2017 and 2021, and the Fresh Start Housing Scheme grant will rise from $35,000 to $50,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Between 2017 and 2021, over 1,800 Malay rental households progressed to home ownership.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: This is more than double the number in the previous five years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: As Minister Desmond Lee mentioned earlier, we will enhance the Fresh Start Housing Scheme, which is for second-timer families with children in public rental.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: We will increase the grant amount from $35,000 to $50,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: We will also expand the scheme to include the purchase of 3-room flats with shorter leases.

sections.label: Government support for construction sector
sections.summary: The Government provided support including the $1.36 billion Construction Support Package, Jobs Support Scheme, Foreign Worker Levy waivers and rebates, and COTMA relief.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: The Government has provided substantial support to help the sector tide over this pandemic.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: This includes the $1.36 billion Construction Support Package, the Jobs Support Scheme, Foreign Worker Levy waivers and rebates, and legislative relief under the COVID-19 (Temporary Measures) Act (COTMA).

sections.label: Amended PSSCOC cost-sharing provisions
sections.summary: Last November, PSSCOC was amended to reduce contractors' need to buffer additional cost in tender bids and to let parties co-share equally relevant pandemic cost increases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Last November, we amended the Public Sector Standard Conditions Of Contract, or PSSCOC, to reduce the need for our contractors to buffer in additional cost in their tender bids.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Second, we included provisions for parties to co-share equally the relevant cost increases incurred due to pandemics – such as labour, plant and equipment, materials or goods and site overhead costs.

sections.label: Streamlined entry requirements for CMP workers
sections.summary: Entry requirements for vaccinated new Work Permit holders in the CMP sectors will be streamlined with effect from 13 March 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: While this arrangement has served the industry well, there is scope to streamline the entry requirements as the COVID-19 situation improves.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: That is why we have recently announced that the entry requirements for vaccinated new Work Permit holders in the Construction, Marine shipyard and Process, or CMP, sectors will be streamlined with effect from 13 March 2022.

sections.label: DfMA adoption in building projects
sections.summary: In 2021, around 44% of building projects by GFA adopted DfMA, and the target of 70% by 2025 remains on track.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: In 2021, around 44% of building projects by gross floor area (GFA) adopted DfMA and we remain on track to meet our target of 70% by 2025.

sections.label: PPVC cost premium decrease
sections.summary: The cost premium for PPVC compared to traditional construction methods decreased from 10% to 15% in 2015 to 7% to 8% in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: The cost premium for PPVC, compared to the traditional construction methods, has decreased from 10% to 15% in 2015 to 7% to 8% in 2019.

sections.label: IDD adoption by GFA
sections.summary: IDD adoption by GFA rose from 20% to 34% in the past year, with progress towards the target of 70% by 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: This digitalisation improves the accuracy of design and planning and reduces abortive work in construction and maintenance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: We have raised IDD adoption by GFA from 20% to 34% in the past year alone and continue to make good progress towards our target of 70% by 2025.

sections.label: Productivity Innovation Project extension
sections.summary: The Productivity Innovation Project scheme will be extended until March 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: First, we will extend the Productivity Innovation Project (PIP) scheme until March 2024.

sections.label: Scheme support since 2010
sections.summary: Since 2010, the scheme has supported more than 3,700 Singaporeans with study costs and sector careers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Since 2010, the scheme has supported more than 3,700 Singaporeans with the costs of their studies and to pursue careers in the sector.

sections.label: CBRE and JTC cost savings
sections.summary: CBRE worked with JTC to achieve up to 15% operational cost savings in building maintenance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: For instance, CBRE has worked with JTC to achieve up to 15% operational cost savings in the maintenance of its buildings, including Space@Tuas and JTC Chemicals Hub.

sections.label: New $30 million FM grant
sections.summary: A new $30 million grant will co-fund up to 70% of initial capital investment and retrofitting costs for integrated and aggregated FM.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: To encourage building owners and the FM industry to adopt these good practices, we will introduce a new $30 million grant, which will co-fund up to 70% of the initial capital investment and retrofitting costs for integrated and aggregated FM.

sections.label: Conditions for FM funding support
sections.summary: Building owners must work with FM firms to install smart infrastructure and integrate at least three FM services for three buildings.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: To qualify for funding support, building owners will need to work with FM firms to install smart infrastructure, such as sensors and intelligent building management systems and rework their procurement practices and processes, to integrate at least three FM services for at least three buildings in their portfolio.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: The grant will be available for a period of three years from the second half of this year.

sections.label: Cities of Tomorrow further investment
sections.summary: Since the 2017 launch of the Cities of Tomorrow programme, $46 million more will be invested in construction and FM innovations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Since the launch of the Cities of Tomorrow (CoT) programme in 2017, we have supported a wide range of R&D efforts for the built environment sector.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: We will further invest $46 million to support innovations for advanced construction and FM.

sections.label: JTM COVID-19 industry transformation
sections.summary: The JTM will study COVID-19 and industry transformation effects and chart targeted interventions for specific roles, concluding in the second half of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: In this regard, the JTM will examine the combined effects of COVID-19 and industry transformation and chart out targeted interventions for specific roles.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: We aim to conclude the JTM in the second half of this year and will work with our IHLs, trade associations and firms to implement the recommendations.

sections.label: Climate change building grants
sections.summary: The government will provide $63 million in grants to retrofit existing buildings and a new $30 million grant for the Facilities Management industry.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: To address climate change, we will make available $63 million in grants to retrofit existing buildings to achieve higher sustainability standards.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: We will launch a new $30 million grant to transform the Facilities Management industry and accelerate the adoption of advanced technologies.

sections.label: NParks pest bird management
sections.summary: NParks will continue working with Town Councils, including Aljunied-Hougang, to manage pest birds in residential areas through habitat modification and food source reduction.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: NParks will continue to work with Town Councils, including Aljunied-Hougang Town Councils, to manage the population of pest birds in residential areas through measures such as habitat modification and food source reduction.

sections.label: NParks briefings to Town Councils
sections.summary: NParks briefed all Town Councils on best practices and findings on 24 February and 17 August 2021, and held a dedicated session for Aljunied-Hougang Town Council on 18 May 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: In fact, on 24 February 2021 and 17 August 2021, NParks briefed all Town Councils on some of the best practices and findings and held a dedicated session for Aljunied-Hougang Town Council on 18 May 2021.

sections.label: HDB estates sky gardens priority schemes
sections.summary: Agencies conduct joint operations against safe distancing violations at sky gardens, and the current information does not detail whether priority schemes are fully allocated for BTO exercises.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: And one of the considerations is the importance of keeping our HDB estates open in terms of their nature.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: I am also glad to update that we have been working, not just with HDB, but also with other agencies like MOM and NEA, in doing joint operations to manage against safe distancing or safe management measure violations at these sky gardens.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: My understanding is that the situation has come under control.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: I note that the current information provided by HDB does not detail whether the respective priority schemes have been fully allocated for a typical BTO exercise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: And to that extent, for example, it is difficult to assess whether the current 30% threshold of priority for married couples with children is at the appropriate level, particularly given the recent demand in public housing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: Can the Minister share, for example, for marriage or priority scheme, whether HDB believes that threshold can be raised?

sections.label: First-timer BTO flat applications
sections.summary: Virtually all first-timers applying for non-mature estate BTO flats should get their flat on the third try.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And the Leader of the Opposition mentioned that he, anecdotally, hears of cases of people who cannot get flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We have said that virtually all who apply as first-timers for non-mature estate BTO flats, virtually all, on the third try, should be able to get their flat.

sections.label: Prime location public housing quota
sections.summary: The MCPS quota for prime location public housing was reduced by five percentage points to allow inclusion and fair access to these flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For the prime location public housing, if the Leader of the Opposition recalls, we had made some adjustments to the MCPS, by reducing the quota available to them, if I recall, five percentage points  , because we considered it and we said that, yes, we want to ensure that children who want to live near their parents in the area can get access to some of these flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But we reduced it because we had a bigger objective, or equally important objective, of allowing inclusion in these estates and allowing people who used to live in other parts of Singapore to also have a fair opportunity to buy a flat in some of these very prime locations.

sections.label: HDB buyback option stopped
sections.summary: When the resale market became mature, HDB stopped the buyback option as a last resort.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: When the resale market became mature, HDB stopped the buyback option as a last resort.

sections.label: Housing eligibility and quotas
sections.summary: Married families and singles face income ceilings, criteria and specific quotas, so absolute priority for one group would use up all spaces.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, even for married families, there are income ceilings, there are different criteria – citizenship, household type.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And then, for singles, when they apply, they have caregiving obligations and they put their parents as essential occupiers, they can get housing – BTO, not just resale.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Or if they are much older and their parents are no longer around and they want to have mutual care and support for single siblings living with each other, we also provide eligibility for them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As I have said before, each group has a specific quota so that we make space for every group that has needs for housing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
