sentences.text: But if we provide absolute priority for certain groups, like the Leader of the Opposition mentioned, households, then, even if you make adjustments for singles, as proposed, it will not come to fruition because all their spaces will be taken up.

sections.label: Reviewing HDB eligibility criteria
sections.summary: HDB has adjusted singles' eligibility for BTO flats and grants over the years and will continue to review its criteria.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We have been looking at social demographic trends all the while and, therefore, the moves on singles through the years, both in allowing them to apply for BTO flats and also adjusting the grants' eligibility along the way.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, we will continue to look at our HDB eligibility criteria and make adjustments where we can.

sections.label: Community Advisory Panel on Noise
sections.summary: The panel will invite community leaders experienced in noise mediation, with public engagement to formulate norms and guide agencies' education advisories.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: For the Community Advisory Panel on Noise, we intend to invite onto this panel community leaders who have experience in handling or mediating issues to do with noise in the neighbourhood.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: And we also plan to have engagements and discussions where members of the public can also take part because the idea is to formulate a set of norms or benchmarks that can be useful in mediating conflicts arising from noise and also to guide our agencies in terms of their public education advisories.

sections.label: Median resale prices of flats
sections.summary: Median resale prices of 5-room flats in Bukit Merah, Queenstown and Toa Payoh range from $800,000 to $900,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: As it is, there are already a lot of public housing flats today in areas where only the better-off can afford them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: But if we look at the median resale prices of, say, a 5-room flat in places, such as Bukit Merah, Queenstown, Toa Payoh, these range from $800,000 to $900,000.

sections.label: Shorter waiting times for flats
sections.summary: Flats have shorter waiting times because available land allowed land preparation and infrastructure development ahead of BTO launches.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The reason why flats have shorter waiting times and, in the case of the most recent launch – two in Yishun, if I am not wrong – it is two years plus to get the flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: That is because the land was available, we were able to carry out the very significant land preparation and infrastructure development to enable those two projects to be launched ahead of time, ahead of our BTO launch, so that when people actually select the flat, the time to them collecting the keys is much less.

sections.label: Sale of Balance Flats options
sections.summary: Sale of Balance Flats and Open Selection of Flats let people select balance units from all over the island.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In addition to that, as I have said in my speech earlier, we have both Sale of Balance Flats options as well as the Open Selection of Flats, where we put the balance units from all over the island and allow people to select.

sections.label: Resale prices and subsidies
sections.summary: Resale prices trended downwards for six of seven years, and subsidies for resale flats go up to $180,000 by income.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In fact, for the last six out of seven years, resale prices have been trending downwards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We provide generous subsidies for those buying resale flats, up to $180,000  , depending on income level, to help with the affordability of resale flats.

sections.label: Solar panels on HDB blocks
sections.summary: Solar panels are committed for 8,400 blocks, with about 2,700 done, roughly 30%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For existing flats, we have committed to emplace solar panels on the roofs of 8,400 blocks and have done so for about 2,700, which is roughly around 30%.

sections.label: EIP-constrained sellers
sections.summary: The EIP announcement focuses on EIP-constrained owners who cannot sell despite marketing flats up to six months at reasonable prices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: On EIP, our announcement focuses on those who are EIP-constrained and, despite marketing their flats for up to six months at reasonable prices, they are not able to sell and can show to HDB their efforts.

sections.label: HDB buyback valuation offer
sections.summary: HDB will appoint a professional valuer and make a fair offer considering the family's specific circumstances.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As I have said, HDB, when considering this buyback option for the seller, will appoint a professional valuer.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will look at the inputs and then make a fair offer, taking into account the specific circumstances that the family is in.

sections.label: Corrections on resale grant and MCPS
sections.summary: The speaker corrects an earlier statement on the resale grant amount and clarifies that MCPS adjustments for the first and second PLH were 30% to 20%, a 10 percentage point cut.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: I just want to make two factual clarifications.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: I misspoke earlier in response to Mr Louis Chua.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: I said that the resale grant is up to $180,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And in relation to the Leader of the Opposition, when I mentioned the MCPS adjustments for the first PLH and second PLH, it was 30% to 20%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, it is a cut of 10 percentage points, rather than five percentage points.
